## Ravenfield VR (next, after 1.16.13)

- The M1 GARRET's operating rod stays back with the bolt when it locks open on the emptied clip (it went forward alone), and is taken there.
- The M1's bolt going home no longer plays its whole reload sound (clip push and all) on every rack.
- Taking a soldier by the neck or the body no longer grabs a second soldier's gun beside him instead.
- Pulling a slide or bolt back plays only its pull, and letting it go home only the slide going home: on many guns the pull played the whole rack, back and home.
